comic.project.label: Project
comic.editor.emptyText: Make a new comic, or pick one from the comic list in the left panel.
comic.page.autoLayout: The layout is automatic and is redone when the panel count changes.
comic.page.exported: The page was saved to the gallery as a picture
comic.pose.title: Panel pose
comic.warning.noPoseModel: The pose model is not installed, so the pose is not used
comic.panel.imageFailed: The picture could not be put in
comic.panel.poseFailed: The pose could not be put in
comic.bubble.kind.caption: Caption
comic.template.name: Template name
comic.template.applyConfirm: The page will have fewer panels. The pictures and balloons of the last panels will be removed. Continue?
comic.warning.combinations: This prompt has {count} combinations. The first is drawn in the panel, and the rest go to the gallery.
comic.shape.cutFailed: That line does not cut the panel in two. Draw it from one edge of the panel to another.
comic.shape.cornerHint: Drag to move. A corner on a straight edge can be removed by double-clicking it.
comic.shape.hint: Drag a corner to change a panel's shape. A corner shared with a neighbouring panel moves with it. Double-click an edge to add a corner. Press "Cut a panel", then draw a line across a panel to split it in two.
comic.shape.custom: The panels' shapes are set by hand. Changing the panel count or the columns puts the automatic layout back.
comic.template.builtin.bigleft: 1 tall panel and 2 on the right
comic.template.builtin.frame: Large center panel in a frame
comic.template.builtin.topcolumns: 2 panels on top, one large below
comic.zoom.wheelHint: You can also zoom by turning the mouse wheel while holding Ctrl
comic.project.empty: No comics yet. Make one with New comic below.
comic.template.pickHint: The template you press is applied to the page on screen.
comic.image.fitContain: Fit the whole picture in the panel
comic.image.rotate: Drag to turn (in 15° steps with Shift)
comic.image.removed: The picture was taken out of the panel. It stays in the gallery.
comic.shape.addPanelFailed: No panel can be added: the page already has as many panels as it can hold.
comic.shape.edgeHint: Drag to move the whole edge (the neighbouring panels follow).
comic.bubble.editHint: Drag to move; double-click to edit.
comic.book.hint: Puts every page of the comic into one file. PDF suits printing and sharing; CBZ suits comic readers. PSD puts one layered file per page into a ZIP, for finishing in a paint program.
comic.free.rotateHint: Drag to turn the panel to any angle (Shift turns in steps of 15 degrees)
comic.readiness.noPrompts: No panel on this page has a prompt
comic.readiness.noPromptsComic: No panel in this comic has a prompt
comic.backdrop.title: Picture over the whole page
comic.backdrop.hint: Puts a picture over the whole page, behind the panels. A panel with no picture of its own shows it through. Drop a picture on the page outside the panels, or on a panel with Alt held. You can also drop it here or pick a file. Press the page outside the panels to select the picture, and Delete to remove it. A picture dropped while it is selected replaces it.
comic.backdrop.edit: Move and reshape on the page
comic.backdrop.removed: Took the picture off the page
comic.reset.title: Back to default
comic.effect.hint: The pictures themselves are not changed; the finish applies to how the page is shown and to the saved picture, PDF and CBZ.
comic.template.builtin.leftstack3: Three on the left, one tall on the right
comic.template.builtin.leftthin3: Narrow three on the left, one tall on the right
comic.template.builtin.rightstack3: One tall on the left, three on the right
comic.template.builtin.leftwide4: Two left, tall right, wide bottom
comic.template.builtin.toprow5: Three on top, large middle, wide bottom
comic.template.builtin.slantrow: Slanted top row of three, two below
comic.template.builtin.ladder: Slanted band between two large panels
comic.template.builtin.slantrows: Two on top, three slant-split rows
comic.bubble.shapeHint: Drag the points to change the shape. Double-click a point to remove it, or the balloon to add one.
comic.bubble.pointHint: Drag to reshape; double-click to remove
comic.bubble.marksHelp: Select words and press a button to make them bold or give them emphasis dots (press it again to take it off). In the field, bold shows as **words** and dots as 《《words》》.
comic.panel.notePlaceholder: For example: the kitchen at night. The older sister waits for her sister, who is late.
comic.panel.noteHelp: A note of the panel's scene. It shows in a panel that has no picture yet, and is not used to make the picture.
comic.bubble.fitHelp: Makes the words smaller until they fit in the balloon and the balloon fits in the panel.
comic.bubble.overflow: The words run out of the balloon
comic.cast.title: Cast
comic.cast.name: Name
comic.cast.tagsPlaceholder: e.g. 1boy, old man, short white hair, flat cap, beige cardigan, blue shirt
comic.cast.help: Write hair, eyes, clothes and so on as English tags, and they are put in front of the prompt as written whenever a panel that has the character is drawn, so the character looks the same in every panel. The agent can write them too.
comic.cast.refSet: Has a reference picture. Panels with this character are drawn from it with FLUX.2, or when Character references is on in the Drawing settings.
comic.cast.refNone: No reference picture. When the panels are drawn with references, a picture of the character alone is drawn first.
comic.stamp.search: Search by word, reading or use
comic.cast.part.face: Face marks (e.g. mole under left eye)
comic.cast.partsHelp: Fill in the parts and a panel gets only the parts it shows: a close-up adds hair, eyes, face and accessories, an upper-body shot adds clothes, and a view from behind leaves out eyes and face. The panel's prompt is read for words such as close-up, upper body or from behind.
comic.cast.nonHuman: Not human (monster, animal, ...): its reference picture is drawn with no person
comic.cast.posePersonNone: Not a person of the pose
comic.cast.posePersonHelp: When a panel has two or more characters, choose which person of the pose each one is: its look and its reference picture then act only around that person, so faces and clothes mix less (with SD 1.5 and SDXL models).
comic.side.label: Agent and panel details
comic.draw.settingsHelp: The model, LoRAs, steps, CFG and so on used to draw this comic. Each comic keeps its own, apart from the Generate tab's.
comic.side.hello: The buttons above send the request for the current stage as it is. To add a wish, write it in the box below and send it.
comic.cast.label.tags: General tags (age, kind and so on)
comic.cast.label.negative: Negative (what to avoid for this character)
comic.cast.negativeHelp: Added to the negative prompt of the panels the character is in. When several people are drawn in regions, it acts only inside that character's region.
comic.draw.scope.label: Settings apply to
comic.draw.scope.help: What you change with "This page only" is used for this page's panels alone. Everything else follows the whole comic.
comic.draw.scope.pageChanged: This page changes some settings from the comic's.
comic.draw.style.title: Style words
comic.draw.style.positive: Quality words (put in front of every panel)
comic.draw.style.help: Words that keep the style of every panel the same. Add your usual artist or style tags (for example (shigure ui:0.5)) to the quality words and every panel gets them. When left empty, default words for the main model are used. To use none, put only a comma instead of leaving it empty.
comic.takes.title: Picture history
comic.takes.empty: When the panel is drawn again or gets another picture, the earlier one stays here.
comic.takes.help: Press a picture to put it back in the panel (the one there now stays in the history). A picture removed from the history stays in the gallery.
comic.fix.title: Redraw a part
comic.fix.surface: Paint over the part to redraw
comic.fix.wordsPlaceholder: What to draw there (English; empty uses the panel prompt)
comic.fix.queued: The painted part is queued to be redrawn. The earlier picture stays in the picture history.
comic.fix.noPicture: The panel needs a picture to redraw a part of it
comic.fix.empty: Paint over the part to redraw on the panel first
comic.fix.noInpaint: This panel's model (FLUX.2) cannot redraw a part of a picture. Redraw the whole panel instead
comic.sheet.title: Character sheet
comic.sheet.help: When the panels are drawn with references (FLUX.2, or Character references on in the Drawing settings), a panel takes the view that fits its framing (from behind, from the side, three-quarter, a close-up of the face) as its reference. The missing views are drawn from the front picture, which is drawn first when there is none.
comic.sheet.noWords: Write this character's words (tags or parts) first
comic.sheet.noFront: The front picture could not be drawn
comic.draw.castReference.title: Character references
comic.draw.castReference.use: Keep faces and clothes with the characters' pictures (IP-Adapter)
comic.draw.castReference.help: When on, each panel uses the reference pictures of its characters through IP-Adapter, lightly and over the first part of the drawing only. It is off by default because it tends to dull the style and to carry the reference picture's white background and stance into the panels. Faces and clothes can also be kept with the characters' words or a LoRA. With FLUX.2, the characters' pictures go to the model itself whatever this setting says.
comic.cast.inPanelHelp: The characters you tick are in the selected panel. Press a name to edit that character's words below.
comic.place.title: Places
comic.place.name: Name of the place
comic.place.tagsPlaceholder: e.g. classroom, wooden desks, green chalkboard, large windows, afternoon sunlight
comic.place.negative: Negative (what to avoid in this place)
comic.place.inPanelHelp: The chosen place's words are added after this panel's prompt. Changing them changes every panel set there. The places are also listed in the Character setup stage.
comic.rough.title: 3D rough
comic.rough.help: Place people, boxes, boards, cylinders and a floor in 3D, and set the camera's direction and angle of view. They become a pose picture and a depth picture, which tell the picture where the people and the set are.
comic.rough.hint: Drag the background to turn the camera, Shift-drag (or right-drag) to slide it, and use the wheel to come closer or move back. Drag a person or a prop to move it on the floor. Drag a colored dot of the chosen person to bend that limb.
comic.rough.nothing: Choose a person or a prop to change its turn and size.
comic.rough.lensHelp: Smaller is a long lens (a picture cut out from far away), larger a wide one (a wide picture from close by).
comic.rough.applied: The 3D rough is in the panel
comic.rough.superseded: The panel's pose changed while the 3D rough was being prepared, so the new pose was kept
comic.rough.failed: The 3D rough could not be put in
comic.rough.inUse: This panel uses the pose and the depth of its 3D rough.
comic.rough.dropped: The pose was changed another way, so the 3D rough's depth is no longer used. Open the 3D rough and use it to make it again with the pose as it is now.
comic.warning.noDepthModel: The depth model is not installed, so the 3D rough's depth is not used
comic.warning.roughOutOfShape: The panel's shape changed since its 3D rough was made, so the depth is not used. Open the 3D rough and press Use this rough again
comic.layers.limitMasks: A page holds at most {max} masks. Delete masks you do not need
comic.layers.limitObjects: A layer holds at most {max} drawn items. Merge layers before you go on
comic.layers.limitRasters: A page holds at most {max} layers (the panels and balloons count). Merge layers or delete the ones you do not need
comic.inpaint.boxFitted: The generation box was fitted around the mask to {width}x{height}
comic.inpaint.noMask: To inpaint, paint on a mask layer first
comic.inpaint.readyElsewhere: An inpaint result for another page has arrived. You can accept it in that page's paint mode
comic.save.largeHint: It is close to the largest size that can be saved (32 MiB). Merge layers to make it smaller.
comic.migrate.turnFailed: A turned picture of an old comic could not be converted
comic.migrate.turnFailedHint: This comic is not saved this time. Check that the original picture is in the gallery, then restart the app.
